第1977章 我不是那个意思（第1页）
情到浓时，君雅思伸手探向了他的皮带，只是手指刚刚碰到了他的皮带却被一只大掌给握住了。
顾少卿嘶哑着声音制止着她，那声音之中的情欲已经浓烈如酒，好似下一秒就会触碰到火苗瞬间燃烧起来一般。
君雅思瞬间就火了，他越是不让，她越是来劲。
挣扎着去扯开他的西装纽扣，只是却被他快一步的再次将自己给制止了。
这样你来我往的好几次，君雅思也是生气了。推开了顾少卿自己坐在了沙发上，就那样看着气喘吁吁的瞪着他。
“你这男人是不是有病？我跟你在一起多少年了？你居然都不想要跟我在一起？我对你来说就那么没有吸引力吗？”
别人谈个恋爱，牵着小手，亲个小嘴，再然后拥抱在一起，最后做情侣间该做的事情。
而顾少卿倒好，跟她在一起多少年了，四年了，这男人还只是停留在可以牵手拥抱接吻的地步。
对于那最后一步，根本就没有要迈出来的想法。
不是说她在乎这样，两个人一定要怎么怎么样，但他这样做，感觉就是对她没有感情似得。
连碰她都不想，越是这么想着，她越是觉得委屈。
眼泪更是吧啦吧啦的往下掉，看着她眼泪掉了，顾少卿心疼了。
之前还觉得火热的情绪瞬间消失的一干二净，连忙起身去哄她。
想要去抱着她，但是手刚刚伸出去，却被君雅思给打开了。
这下顾少卿急眼了，两人好不容易见到一次，这要是吵架了，下一次在想要见到她，还不知道是什么时候了。
“那你是什么意思？都这样了不是这个意思，你就觉得我比你小，好欺负。”
说着，那眼泪更是止不住的掉，就像是那断了线的珍珠似得。
“我告诉你顾少卿，你要是不喜欢我，你乘早跟我说，我们好聚好散，我以后也会找到真的爱我，喜欢我的男人。”
这话就越说越严重了，顾少卿见她还有继续说下去的趋势，也是没有办法了，立即起身直接擒住了她的双唇，将她所有的话都堵在了喉咙里。
君雅思挣扎着想要推开他，但是顾少卿哪里会肯？直接将她抱着放在了自己的腿上。
直到她被自己吻得晕乎乎的时候，顾少卿这才放开了她。
只是此刻的她却喘息着连说话的力气都没有了，只能够用眼睛狠狠地瞪着他。
不过，这样的瞪眼根本就没有半点威胁力，对于顾少卿来说，反倒是娇俏的可爱。
他喉结上下滚动了好几番，用自己强大的自制力将心里的躁动给压了下去。
“丫头，你在冤枉我之前，可不可以感受下我？”
他话语里带着委屈，像是在控诉君雅思。
此刻君雅思这样坐在他的怀中，自然是感受到的，一张脸瞬间涨的通红。什么话都不说，只是反驳了她之前所有的控诉与委屈。

Chapter 1977 I didn’t mean that (page 1)
When the love was intense, Jun Yasi reached out to reach for his belt, but just as her fingers touched his belt, she was grabbed by a big hand.
Gu Shaoqing stopped her with a hoarse voice. The lust in that voice was already as strong as wine, as if it would burn instantly if it touched the flames the next second.
Jun Yasi became angry instantly. The more he refused to let her go, the more excited she became.
She struggled to unbutton his suit, but he quickly stopped her again.
You came and went with me several times like this, and Jun Yasi also became angry. She pushed Gu Shaoqing away and sat on the sofa, staring at him panting.
"Are you a sick man? How many years have I been with you? You don't even want to be with me? Am I so unattractive to you?"
Others fall in love, hold hands, kiss each other, then hug each other, and finally do what lovers should do.
Gu Shaoqing, on the other hand, has been with her for how many years, four years, and this man is still only able to hold hands, hug and kiss.
For that last step, there was no thought of taking it.
It's not that she cares about this, the two of them must be like each other, but when he does this, it feels like he has no feelings for her.
She didn't even want to touch her. The more she thought about it, the more aggrieved she felt.
Tears fell even more. Gu Shaoqing felt heartbroken when she saw her tears falling.
The hot emotions I felt before disappeared completely in an instant, and I quickly got up to comfort her.
He wanted to hug her, but as soon as he stretched out his hand, Jun Yasi opened it.
Now Gu Shaoqing was anxious. It was hard for the two of them to see each other once. If they had a quarrel, he didn't know when the next time he wanted to see her would be.
"Then what do you mean? It's already like this. That's not what you mean. You think I'm younger than you and easy to bully."
As he spoke, the tears couldn't stop falling, like pearls with broken strings.
"Let me tell you Gu Shaoqing, if you don't like me, tell me as soon as possible so that we can get together and have a good time. I will also find a man who really loves me and likes me in the future."
The words became more and more serious. Gu Shaoqing saw that she had the tendency to continue talking and had no choice. He immediately stood up and captured her lips directly, blocking all her words in her throat.
Jun Yasi struggled to push him away, but how could Gu Shaoqing be willing? He directly held her on his lap.
It wasn't until she was dizzy from being kissed by him that Gu Shaoqing let her go.
But at this moment, she was panting and didn't even have the strength to speak, so she could only stare at him fiercely with her eyes.
However, such a glare was not threatening at all. To Gu Shaoqing, it was rather cute and cute.
His Adam's apple rolled up and down several times, and he used his strong self-control to suppress the restlessness in his heart.
"Girl, before you wrongly accuse me, can you feel me?"
There was grievance in his words, as if he was accusing Jun Yasi.
At this moment, Jun Yasi was sitting in his arms like this. Naturally, he felt it, and his face instantly turned red. He didn't say anything, he just refuted all her previous accusations and grievances.
